title: strict-typing row reads done while manifest requirement threadpoolctl ships no py.typed and has no stub package
claim: quality_scale.yaml marks strict-typing done, but one of the three manifest requirements, threadpoolctl, ships no py.typed (3.7.0 installed, 3.8.0 as pinned in tests/requirements-typing.txt) and has no types-/-stubs distribution, which the rule (no exceptions) and its hassfest check require.
mechanism: The row's comment reads the rule's py.typed half as the integration's own marker (qs_py_typed_files=1), but the rule page says 'Its library must be typed as well, and ship a py.typed file' and hassfest checks 'every requirement in its manifest must ship a py.typed file, or have a separate types- stubs package'. optimizer.py:1447 itself records that threadpoolctl publishes no py.typed and no stub distribution exists, and resolves it by importlib to dodge import-untyped. tests/entities.py derives the manifest tier from these rows, so the manifest's quality_scale: platinum rests on the false row. Fails D10-criteria Q2.

evidence.machine: macOS arm64, orchestrator box B3, venv-ci python 3.14.7
evidence.contention_note: shared box under heavy finder load (load1 147-260); counts are contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb req (threadpoolctl dropped from the manifest requirements in memory) or --perturb row (strict-typing read as todo)

metric_definition: untyped_requirements_under_done_row: manifest requirements with no py.typed and no types-/-stubs dist (installed or typing-lock pinned) while strict-typing is done
phenomenon_property: A done strict-typing row holds only if every manifest requirement is typed (py.typed in the distribution, or a stub distribution).
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D10/s3/platinum_rules.py | grep '^REQ'   (add --pinned to judge the typing lock's versions)

null_control.note: with the row at todo the claim vanishes; numpy (py.typed) and scipy (scipy-stubs pinned) count 0 at baseline

proposed_fix_scope: Either make the requirement typed (upstream py.typed / a stub package, or drop threadpoolctl for a typed equivalent) or set strict-typing to todo with the reason, letting tests/entities.py re-derive the manifest tier (gold). Correct the row comment's reading of the py.typed half.
